about: needed_by.rs's per-source tables and their mirrors in the window, read by the tests on both sides (needed_by.rs, src/lib/neededBy.test.ts).

batch_hosted_leaves_out.pip: Banager uninstalls none of pip's packages, so none is ever in a batch for the host rule (X5) to protect; the Homebrew Python pip runs on is named by the preview's own NeededBySource, which leaves it out of a batch first (X1b).
